tools.name: tiktok_video_detail
tools.description: Fetch full metadata, engagement metrics, creator info, music track, and 1080p HD no-watermark MP4 stream URLs (hdplay) for a TikTok video URL or ID (10 credits).

tools.name: tiktok_video_search
tools.description: Search public TikTok videos by keyword with region, sort order, and publish window filters. Costs 2 credits per video ($0.20 / 1,000 videos).

tools.name: tiktok_trending_feed
tools.description: Get currently trending public TikTok videos for a target two-letter country code (2 credits per video).

tools.name: tiktok_user_info
tools.description: Retrieve a TikTok creator profile (numeric user_id, secUid, bio, verification, business category) and real-time follower/heart/video counts (10 credits).

tools.name: tiktok_user_posts
tools.description: Fetch public videos posted by a TikTok creator with no-watermark MP4 streams and engagement stats (2 credits per video).

tools.name: tiktok_user_followers
tools.description: Get paginated follower accounts of a TikTok creator (up to 200 per call, 1 credit per follower).

tools.name: tiktok_user_following
tools.description: Get paginated accounts followed by a TikTok creator (up to 200 per call, 1 credit per user).

tools.name: tiktok_user_search
tools.description: Search TikTok creators by niche keyword with follower-tier and verified badge filters (1 credit per creator).

tools.name: tiktok_comment_list
tools.description: Fetch top-level comments on a TikTok video (up to 50 comments per call, 1 credit per comment).

tools.name: tiktok_comment_replies
tools.description: Fetch nested reply threads for a specific comment on a TikTok video (1 credit per reply).

tools.name: tiktok_challenge_info
tools.description: Get TikTok hashtag challenge metadata, numeric challenge_id, and total view/video counts (10 credits).

tools.name: tiktok_challenge_posts
tools.description: Fetch public videos tagged with a TikTok hashtag challenge_id (2 credits per video).

tools.name: tiktok_music_info
tools.description: Get TikTok sound/music metadata, MP3 playback URL, author, duration, and usage count. Accepts a music ID, music URL, or video URL (10 credits).

tools.name: tiktok_music_posts
tools.description: Fetch public TikTok videos using a specific numeric music_id (2 credits per video).

tools.name: tiktok_top_ads
tools.description: Search top-performing commercial ads from TikTok Creative Center by keyword, country, period, and CTR/impression rank.

tools.name: tiktok_ad_detail
tools.description: Get full creative telemetry, 1080p ad video URL, CTR curve, and landing page URL for a TikTok Creative Center ad ID (10 credits).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tiktok_video_detail, tiktok_trending_feed, tiktok_user_posts, tiktok_comment_list, tiktok_comment_replies, tiktok_challenge_posts, tiktok_music_info, tiktok_music_posts, tiktok_ad_detail · Public sink: tiktok_video_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tiktok_video_detail, tiktok_trending_feed, tiktok_user_posts, tiktok_comment_list, tiktok_comment_replies, tiktok_challenge_posts, tiktok_music_info, tiktok_music_posts, tiktok_ad_detail · Public sink: tiktok_video_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
